title: Assorted Free Standing Accessorie 49-Inch Towel Stand, 4 Pivoting Swing Arms, Solid Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Add flexible towel storage with an assorted free standing accessorie floor standing towel stand. This freestanding towel holder / towel rack uses 4 pivoting swing arms to maximize hanging space without wall mounting.

Highlights:
- Freestanding design requires no wall mounting (ideal when you can’t drill)
- 4 pivoting swing arms help keep towels separated and easy to reach
- Solid brass construction
- Heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping
- Felt pad helps prevent scratching on surfaces
- Available in multiple designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs:
- Mounting type: Freestanding
- Material: Brass
- Dimensions: 49-Inch height x 12-Inch length x 10.5-Inch width
- Product weight: 13.6 lb
- Assembly required: Yes
- Included items: Towel stand
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Style/SEO terms: traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, heritage bathroom fixtures, freestanding.

Towel stand has 4 pivoting arms so that you can maximize your space. Large base is weighted to help prevent tipping. Towel stand is made of the finest solid brass materials so that it will not rust or corrode and is provided with one of our designer lifetime finishes.
